mapper.select: SELECT id, todo_id, stored_filename, original_filename, content_type, file_size, created_at FROM todo_attachments WHERE todo_id = #{todoId} ORDER BY id
SELECT a.stored_filename FROM todo_attachments a INNER JOIN todos t ON t.id = a.todo_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo_attachments (todo_id, stored_filename, original_filename, content_type, file_size) VALUES (#{todoId}, #{storedFilename}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize})
